final_policy: Never opened by this development screening; audit entire history before any future final campaign
training_seed_namespace: 100000000 + replicate*1000000 + episode_index*8 + env_id; fresh seeds checked against all prior logged resets
checkpoint_selection: highest mean deterministic return on development; earliest step on ties; checkpoint hashes locked before assessment
matched_design: all four arms share actor/critic initialization, episode scenario IDs, minibatch RNG and transition budget within each replicate
payload_branch: local semantic width12 schema4: BS existing5 + 4 believed power fractions under previous profile/delayed estimate + mean pair coherence real/imag + max log norm; RIS existing6 with corrected previous group-count metadata + 4 relative per-user log norms + spatial phase contrast cos/sin; MA existing4 + 4 relative per-user log norms + local layout offset mean/std in y/z
payload_information_boundary: only each sender's delayed estimated channel component, own pre-action actuator state and previous action; no realized reward/outage, no true channel, no fresh post-action estimates
router_branch: original payload; equal-priority ties rotate by episode step modulo3; priorities, metadata, graph, budget, delay and cost unchanged
fixed_settings: frozen physics/reward/codebooks/network/Adam/joint clipping/entropy0.01; raw actor projection; no combination of ablations
diagnostic_basis: outputs_marl/paper_v4/diagnostics: 720 development episodes of 8 locked v3 checkpoints; normal-minus-off negative for all 8 policies; weak content benefit and redundant BS/MA channels; not a final-data selection
assessment_role: additional development screening only, not confirmatory superiority/significance evidence
advancement_criteria: descriptive candidate only: selected mean net return greater than comm reference and gain in >=2/3 matched replicates; candidate normal-minus-off and normal-minus-fixed-send-zero means both positive; report sensing/outage tradeoffs for review; never automatically open final
statistics: 10000 paired nested bootstrap resamples over matched policies and shared development scenarios; descriptive uncertainty only with 3 replicates
